title: Average velocity
caution: The CED denotes position by the vector r (1.1.A.4.ii), so the displacement here is the change in the position vector. Along a single axis the component form is used instead, for example average v_x = change in x over change in t (1.2.C.1.i).
ced_evidence: 1.2.B.2 "Average velocity is the displacement of an object divided by the interval of time in which that displacement occurs."
